residual_findings.title: handleSave chains non-atomic state/transition/prompt mutations
residual_findings.note: Partially resolved in the fix wave. The canvas now tracks workingRevision and bumps it after each successful partial patch, and it refetches canonical state on conflict. However, handleSave still issues up to three sequential mutateAsync calls (state, transition, prompt template) with no compensating rollback if a later call fails after earlier ones succeeded. Each patch is atomic on the daemon, but the UI-level multi-patch save is not a unified transaction. Either split saves per inspector section or add compensating logic and partial-failure UI before V1.71 ships.
residual_findings.closure_note: Closed in V1.72 P1: split StrategyCanvas into per-inspector-section saves (state, transition, prompt template). Each section owns its own save button, active-inspector Cmd/Ctrl+S handling, and per-call success/error status. A failure in one section does not roll back or lose draft changes in the others; each patch remains atomic on the daemon. Documented the no-rollback decision in the strategy-canvas.tsx module doc-comment. Verified by pnpm --filter web typecheck/build/test and cargo clippy --all / cargo test --all.

residual_findings.closure_note: Verified by qc3 rev2 code inspection and web typecheck/test/build evidence.

residual_findings.title: Prompt-template patch writes the file before domain validation
residual_findings.note: File is written before validate_preset_yaml runs. A 422 validation failure leaves the bundle with a mutated prompt-template but unchanged preset.yaml/revision, producing a partial/inconsistent state.
residual_findings.closure_note: patch_prompt_template now stages the template file via temp + rename, then runs full preset YAML validation before committing the preset.yaml bump. On validation failure the staged template is removed and preset.yaml is left untouched.

residual_findings.title: No serialization around the read-modify-write of preset.yaml
residual_findings.note: Concurrent requests with the same base_revision can both pass the precondition, compute the same new_revision, and rename their temp files, resulting in last-write-wins with duplicate revision numbers.
residual_findings.closure_note: All three mutation handlers now run inside tokio::task::spawn_blocking, acquire an advisory flock on bundle/.strategy-lock, re-check base_revision after lock acquisition, and write preset.yaml atomically with fsync. Concurrent requests with the same base_revision are serialized; the second re-check fails CAS and returns 409.

residual_findings.title: Prompt-template body write remains non-atomic if YAML revision persistence fails after validation
residual_findings.note: Prompt-template patch now rolls back the committed template file if YAML revision persistence fails after validation, preserving the invariant that on-disk prompt bytes and preset.yaml revision advance together or not at all. Failure-injection regression coverage added.
residual_findings.closure_note: Verified resolved by qc3 rev3: patch_prompt_template_inner calls write_preset_yaml through a rollback guard; any YAML persistence error triggers rollback_template_write to restore the original template bytes before returning the error. The rollback helper logs rollback write failures with tracing::error!, so rollback failure is observable rather than silent.
